Title: Marvelous Designer Silent Install (No GUI Installation)
Content: You can install Marvelous Designer software without a GUI using the commands described below. This is convenient when installing Marvelous Designer software in an environment with multiple PCs, such as a school or company. Windows 1 Search for Command Prompt (CMD) in Windows Search and run it as administrator. 2 Enter the following into the Command Prompt: MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer_x64.exe /S /USERNAME=&ltWindows Login ID&gt /D=&ltMD install path&gt eg) MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer_x64.exe /S /USERNAME=johndoe /D=C:Program FilesMarvelous Designer 12 Enterprise OnlineAuth Enter the above command in the path where the Marvelous Designer installer is saved. Please rename it to the name of the actual downloaded installation file. (eg:MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer_x64.exe) USERNAME is the user name you see when you log in to Windows. Depending on your Windows login permissions, a User Account Control warning window may appear. If you see a UAC warning, click Yes to continue the installation. macOS 1 Download the attached script file. 2 Run Terminal.app on your Mac. 3 Enter the following into the Terminal: sh install_md_dmg.sh /Users/&ltusername&gt/downloads/MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer.dmg MarvelousDesigner12Online.app ex1) sh install_md_dmg.sh /Users/johndoe/MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer.dmg MarvelousDesigner12Online.app ex2) sh install_md_dmg.sh /Users/johndoe/MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Offline_Annual_7_2_209_Installer.dmg MarvelousDesigner12Offline.app Please rename it to the name of the actual downloaded installation file. (example:MarvelousDesigner12_Enterprise_Online_7_2_209_Installer_x64.dmg) USERNAME is the user name you see when you log in to Mac. For macOS, the App name you must enter varies depending on the type of Marvelous Designer product you want to install. Please check the product name carefully before entering it. MarvelousDesigner12Online.app - Enterprise user, OnlineAuth MarvelousDesigner12Offline.app - Enterprise user, OfflineAuth

Title: What is the cost of updating to the next version after purchasing a perpetual license?
Content: If you have already purchased the previous version of the license, you can update to the next version at 75% of the full license price. For those with an older version of the license, you can update for 60% of the full license price. However, please note that updates cannot be purchased for versions that are more than three versions behind the latest version, according to our 3-Versions-back policy. After we changed our license policy in November 2020, it is no longer possible to purchase new perpetual licenses. However, users who already have a perpetual license can purchase license updates up to Version 12. Once Version 12 is released, perpetual license updates will no longer be available, and only license trade-in purchases will be possible. *Trade-in purchase will be available until December 31, 2024.

Title: Can I use Marvelous Designer for physical garment production?
Content: Marvelous Designer is generally used in the video production or the game industries to create virtual garments and props, which means that Marvelous designer does not offer several functions that are essential in physical garment production. (e.g. to import/export DXF, to print out the paper patterns). If you are looking for a software to help you with proceeding the physical garment, we would like to introduce you to our sister software 'CLO 3D.' Visit www.clo3d.com or contact us at sales@clo3d.com

Title: Trim Properties (ver. 2024.0)
Content: Set the properties of a Trim. When you select a Trim, the properties of that object appear in the Properties pane. Trim properties Properties Description Information Name You can rename the trim. Surface Skin Offset Adjusts the spacing between objects and trim. Static Friction This is the coefficient of friction between the garment and the accessories when the garment is stationary. Kinetic Friction It refers to the coefficient of friction between the garment and its accessories in situations where the garment needs to move. Specification Scale (local) X (mm) Scales along the X-axis. Y (mm) Scales along the Y-axis. Z (mm) Scales along the Z-axis. Lock Aspect Ratio Fix the default proportions of the trim. Weight Set the weight of the trim. Collision (ver 11) Sets whether the accessory should collide. You can only set collision handling for accessories that are not attached to a garment. Collision Thickness Sets the thickness of the collision with the clothing. The higher the thickness value, the wider the simulated gap with the garment. Material (selected) Set the Material of the trims Miscellaneos Mesh type This indicates the type of mesh. Element Count Indicates the number of points in the mesh. Polygon Optimization Count Sets the number of polygons. Plane Applied in the form of a texture when the Plane is activated. Count cannot be set on Plane activation.

Title: Fold Seam Line
Content: Objective Use this function to create an pressing effect on sewn parts of Patterns. Location Pattern Property Editor Fold Fold Angle Operation Click on Edit Sewing tool. Select the seamline to change its fold angle. Follow the indicated guideline below: Pattern Property Editor Fold Fold Angle Adjust the value, in the range of 0~360. Note: The value of fold angle is in between 0 to 360, 180 represents a flat state. The internal line is folded towards the front of the pattern as the fold angle is closer to 0, and is folded into the back of the pattern as the angle is closer to 360. Fold Strength The intensity of the fold is able to be set by adjusting the value of Fold Strength. The higher the value, the closer the fold is to the set angle. When a jacket and its lining are sewn together, the sewn area inflates due to the default sewing angle and intensity values. In this case, sets the Fold Strength to 0 to flatten the sewn boundaries. When the Sewing type is set as Turned, Fold Strength and Fold Angle cannot be modified (ver4.0.0).

Title: Shirring and Crease Principle
Content: Shirring principle In this course, we will explore the different types of shirring shapes based on fabric. In addition to the wrinkles generated by the default fabric, there are various types of wrinkles, such as narrow wrinkles and wide wrinkles. You can achieve the desired wrinkles by adjusting the Detail items in the Fabric Property, but it may be challenging for beginners. However, if you understand the differences in how each fabric forms wrinkles, you can easily create various styles of wrinkles. Crease principle In this course, we will learn about the shape of creases based on fabric. When fabrics are stretched or overlapped with each other, various creases are formed based on the type of fabric. Following the Shirring principle, you can refer to the creases made for each fabric and apply them to the clothes you plan to create in the future.

Title: ANIMATION MODE: Wind Animation
Content: Save Wind animation property by frame (Ver. MD 7) Objective Create or delete wind animation key Location Animation Mode Animation Editor Operation Creating Wind Animation Key Create a pattern to apply Wind animation. Navigate to the menu indicated in Location. Main menu&gtDisplay&gtEnvironment&gt Check 'Show Wind Controller' Can adjust wind property when Wind Controller is displayed. Select the Wind controller and move Playhead to the frame where Wind animation key will be applied on Timeline Wind controller will move along intermediate value if move Playhead after Wind animation key is set, Need to move Playhead first before set wind property, in order to locate wind controller to desired position. Wind property will displayed when select Wind controller on 3D window. Use Gizmo to adjust Wind controller's position and direction. Check properties want to apply and input value. Rotation and position of the wind are available to adjust by Gizmo on 3D window. Right click on Playhead on time line. Select 'Add key' on popup menu to save wind property. Add key menu will not show up if wind controller is not selected. When Wind Animation key is set, Wind property values will be applied gradually to the next key. For example, if Wind strength of first frame is 500 and last frame is 1000, Wind strength will gradually increase 500 ~ 1000 from first frame to last frame. When Wind Animation key is set and there is no existing next Wind animation key, Wind property of the key will be applied from the key to the end of the frame. Wind Property will be applied when recording animation. Checking Wind Animation Key Check position and rotation of wind controller of each frame by moving Playhead on time line, after adding Wind Animation key on 3D window. Deleting key Select Wind controller. Wind Animation keys will be displayed on Animation timeline. Select a key and right click. Select 'Delete Key' on pop up menu to delete selected Wind Animation key. Available to delete multiple keys by Area select. Move Playhead to the start point of desired area and click the end of the area while pressing 'Shift' key. Delete all key of selected area by right click on selected area&gt select Delete Key on popup menu.

Title: Troubleshooting with HASP Driver Errors
Content: The Latest HASP driver download (updated June 2022) Mac version Linux version Windows version Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on Windows Objective The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Sentinel HASP Driver which is suitable for your operating system. Operation Installing Sentinel Driver on Windows 1. Download the driver from the link below. Windows HASP Driver Download 2. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to install the driver. 3. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-i" behind the automatically entered path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to install. 4. Access to http://localhost:1947 and check to see if the following screen appears to see if the HASP Driver has been successfully installed. If the following screen appears, then installation is successful. 5. If the following error occurs, the HASP Driver must be deleted and reinstalled. Deleting Sentinel Driver on Windows 1. Download the driver from the link below. HASP Driver Download 2. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to delete the driver. 3. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-purge -r" behind the corresponding path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to delete. 4. After the driver has been successfully deleted, refer to reinstall the driver. Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on MAC Objective The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Mac OS Sentinel HASP Driver. Operation Installing Sentinel Driver on Mac * Sentinel Driver for Mac Download 1. Please remove all the dongle keys inserted into the Mac for installation to be done correctly. 2. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" (ver 21.0 Build 77815) 3. Double-click the Install Sentinel Runtime Environment icon. 4. Please allow the 'hasplmd' application to accept incoming network connections (this message may not appear). 5. Access to http://localhost:1947 6.If you are unable to connect to the URL, try again after 10 seconds later. If it still does not work, reboot and connect again. If the solutions above do not work, please go back to the first step and check again. *If you click Diagnostics, License Manager Version appears with newly installed version ver 21.0 Build 77815 (Version information of 21.0 Build 77815 appears as this in Diagnostics). 7. Insert Dongle key into USB port. 8. If the Dongle key appears in 'Sentinel Keys', the installation is successfully done. Reinstalling Sentinel on Mac 1. Please remove all the dongle keys from USB port. 2. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" with version of "ver 21.0 Build 77815". 3.Double-click Uninstall Sentinel Runtime Environment. 4. Click Uninstall. 5.If the un-installation is done normally, the dialog above appears. Please press OK button and then click Quit. 6.Reboot your Mac. 7.Install Sentinel Driver. Please refer to the following method *If you don't follow the guideline, you may not be able to find Dongle keys inserted into your PC or other PCs. Also the other PCs may not be able to find your Dongle key. Sentinel Driver Known Bugs * Sentinel LDK Protection System Error : invalid XML scope (36) Normally occurred when operating in Marvelous Designer modelist network dongle 1.4.14.7701 (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 6.4 version or before 6.4). * Occurs with the following conditions: Network Dongle key (not a local Dongle key) Marvelous Designer Modelist Network with 2.1.44 or later version. (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 7.1) The Dongle key is inserted into another PC. The version of Sentinel Driver is 13.20 in your Mac. Operates normally after reinstalling with Mac Sentinel Driver ver 16.0. * If multiple Sentinel Drivers are mounted, the software is unable to find virtual files. If a driver is already mounted, please demount(or eject) it and mount new driver. * Sentinel Driver starts to operate in a few seconds. On occasion, it does not start. In that case, please reboot your PC. * All the Dongle keys should be removed when uninstalling Sentinel Driver.
